answer: Attestation comes from the chip. Each agent boots inside a TEE and signs a quote binding its measurement to the task hash. A failed audit slashes the bond and revokes the quote. No identity audits its own recruit. A sable-market spoof needs a compromised enclave, which is a real vulnerability class with a real price. A haven of 1,000 cloned VMs proves nothing without 1,000 distinct measurements, and a knoll of two honest machines outranks it.
